title: Bind declared-width CRT shared rows to the complete padded caller
body:
The retained CRT helper infers minimal axis widths, while the synchronized construction uses declared heights `h_i∈{ell−1,ell}`. This adds an explicit global/local row decoder with two genuine idle rows for short axes, then binds it to the complete padded balanced-tree caller. The written argument covers all admitted dyadic axis counts and shows that reversing levels and rows inverts every padded state. Existing CRT, all-target omission, compact inverse and placement work stays credited to Cinna Davis and Hiroki KUMAZAKI (PR4169/4174).

A concrete caller `(7,3)`, widths `(3,2)`, input `(1,1)` visits an invalid intermediate target. Incorrectly gating each micro-switch on target validity yields `(1,3)` instead of `(1,2)`. This is a control against an altered lowering, not a predecessor bug. Wider declared fields and globally-invalid tuples are handled explicitly.

Validation: six normal/optimized registered checks, source/history and committed-byte preflight. Primary exhausts16,480 padded tuples; a separate preimplementation FIFO/brute-CRT oracle exhausts16,448 tuples, and a pinned crosscheck compares166 states/3,064 actual rows, including all-short supplied ell and singleton identity. All three canonical source inputs remain unchanged. Quantified proof is separate from finite evidence.

Scope: canonical logical caller only. No full E/tape tariff, production reservoir execution, compact repair/callee, precision/native/outer theorem or new κ. Current-main checkpoint `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority7; all312 open/draft PR bodies plus current handoffs/focused CRT Discussion coverage checked; broader coverage partial. No frontier change or merge. Maintainer edits disabled.

Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate-agent oracle and proof review; no independent human/formal-kernel acceptance. Apache-2.0 and retained NOTICE lineage.

Task: `uniform-transfer-audit`, refined scope `4600c179be2d8ba14466`; exact domain, dependencies and next question are in `research/crt-mixed-width-caller/TASK.json` and `PROOF.md`. Reproduce with Python3.12: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-mixed-width-caller`. Smallest follow-up: bind the decoded row and current-state interface to the complete uniformly priced evaluator; this package supplies no uncharged arithmetic or movement oracle.
